summaryZh: Smarr 实验室研究生命如何利用时间组织生理活动，以及现代生活时间安排与身体节律之间的关系。页面以个人数字轨迹和可穿戴传感器产生的时间序列数据为研究背景，旨在为健康、教育与社会时间选择提供依据。
researchQuestions: 生命如何利用时间，现代社会时间安排如何与身体节律相互作用？
methods: 官方档案所述负责人研究：生物系统时间序列分析
负责人 TemPredict 项目：整合可穿戴设备数据与每日症状报告

evidence.quote: UCSD Smarr lab Prof. Benjamin Smarr & Lab
Understand how life uses time. Use this knowledge to improve health, education, and the world.
Now that individuals generate data across time with digital trails and wearable sensors, we can begin to see how humans evolved to use time to orchestrate their bodies.
Modern life often conflicts with natural time by imposing social demands that go against the rhythms of our bodies.

Smarr’s research focuses on time series analysis in biological systems, with an emphasis on practical information extraction for translational applications. Currently his main project is TemPredict, which brings together wearable device data from 50K people with over 1 million daily symptom reports. This massive data object is being used to identify signs of COVID-19 onset, progression, and recovery.
evidence.provenanceNote: 明确限定为负责人Benjamin Smarr的研究和具名TemPredict项目；不将主页的背景介绍推广为全实验室统一采用。 档案原文称Currently，但正文没有独立更新时间；保留该档案所述范围，不据2026-10-16捕获时间断言项目当时仍正在实施。
